case_name: Cache-Memory-Leak-007
problem_category: Stability
problem_subcategory: Memory
root_case_conclusion: Local cache eviction policy not triggered, heap grew to 1.8G then OOM
fix_action: Switch cache to Caffeine with maximumSize=10000 + expireAfterWrite=10m
